scope: personal-use; one speaker; exploratory data only

sessions.instructions: First session; do not reuse earlier exploratory clips.
Separate later sitting, preferably another day; never move into training.
Do not collect or inspect until training recipe and validation decision rule are frozen.

positive_prompts.instructions: One second silence, say Kural naturally once, one second silence.
Same chosen wake word, natural Tamil/Tanglish pronunciation. Vary normal pace, not a different phrase.
Say the wake naturally before this short question. Annotate only the wake interval.

background_blocks.condition: approved narration playback over speakers; do not speak
approved narration playback over speakers; do not speak

annotation.rule: Set actual intervals only after replay; if unintended literal wake occurs in negative/background, annotate rather than silently label negative. Playback literal wakes are lexical positives but unwanted self-activations.

lineage_rule: original, all crops and augmentations keep speaker_id, session_id, split and original recording_id; no cross-split copies
exclusions: existing six positives and crops: exploratory only
recordings and private manifests remain in ignored tools/local_wake_data or Downloads
negative_variation: Across repetitions vary natural sentence context, pace and distance around each negative phrase; do not deliberately say the actual wake. Write what was heard during annotation if uncertain.
